# Cumulus Digital

> Cumulus Digital Limited is a web design and digital marketing agency based in Hersham, Surrey, UK (company number 09893216), serving small and medium businesses across Surrey and the South East since 2015. Services: web design, web development, SEO, AI SEO / answer engine optimisation (AEO), Google Ads management, and specialist work for the travel industry and for trades and construction firms. Contact: info@cumulusdigital.co.uk, 020 8050 4754.

Cumulus Digital builds hand-coded, fast websites rather than templated ones, and runs search marketing with plain-English monthly reporting through its own platform, Cumulus Rank & Reporting. The team works month to month with no long contracts, and clients own their own accounts and websites.

## Services

- [Web Design](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/web-design/): Bespoke, conversion-focused website design for Surrey businesses.
- [Web Development](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/web-development/): Hand-built, fast, accessible sites and web applications.
- [SEO](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/seo/): Local, technical and content SEO for Surrey businesses, including Google Business Profile management.
- [AI SEO & AEO](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/ai-seo/): Answer engine optimisation — getting businesses recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity and cited in Google's AI Overviews.
- [Google Ads](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/google-ads/): Search, Shopping, Performance Max and remarketing management.
- [Travel Industry](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/travel-industry/): Websites and marketing for travel companies, built on 25 years of trade experience.
- [Trades & Construction](https://cumulusdigital.co.uk/services/trades/): Websites and lead generation for tradespeople and construction firms.
